last_result.headline: Q48 reviewed 11 non-active rows: 1 re-queued, 6 closed, 4 confirmed deferred. q28 was re-opened because its own trigger fired -- four measurement traps in ~6 hours, including a 12-well smoke that PASSED the gate the 760-well run FAILED -- and is narrowed to a bounded traps ledger. The most valuable closure is q25: an ensemble is now harmful rather than unevidenced, because best-of-2 is a call option on variance and an ensemble has lower variance by construction -- simulation at Q44's implied sd gives E[min(p1,p2)] -0.954 vs E[min(E,p1)] -0.475, so an ensemble slot EXACTLY HALVES the option value (+0.479 ft) and using it twice destroys it (+0.958). q24's objective was achieved externally for free by Q45's 14-resubmission noise measurement. Also closed q23 (superseded by Q39 with no run, residual stages below Q45's readability floor), q32/q34 (merged/duplicate), and q17's held row which carried can_submit=true with no recorded reason. Every row now has an explicit reason.

final_pair_note: Q44/Q45: slot 2 is settled at 54844628 on measured grounds (worth ~0.46 ft mean / ~0.94 ft tail as the decorrelated member of a best-of-2, and the only submission we hold whose error is decorrelated from the crowd). Slot 1 is TIED ON MEASUREMENT between 54922806 (teammate, 6.563) and 54968060 (ours, 6.643): the 0.080 gap is 2.7 sd of the measured 0.03 public floor, and its only resolvable component is the GR-sigma term Q36 measured as not transferring.
